name: workflow_doctor
title: Check workflow setup
description: Check that the repository has the workflow file and the settings it needs

name.description: Name of the workflow template (board-sync, review, handoff, auto, github-ops)

directory.description: Root of the target Git repository (absolute or relative path; default: the current directory)

name.description: What was checked: the workflow file, the template version, a secret or variable, or the Claude GitHub App (only for a template that uses it)

state.description: ok, missing, outdated, or skipped (not readable with the token; not counted as missing)

items.description: Checked items in the order of the output lines

ready.description: Whether nothing is missing or outdated

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
